name: intro_splash
how: Switch the incubator off and on; capture during the 5-15 s start-up screen.

name: main_all_off
how: Main screen, all functions off, no alarms (green check), clock set.

name: main_patient_heading
how: Main screen with a registered baby: name and CGA line in the header.

name: main_air_mode_on
how: Temperature ON in air mode (TURN ON > wizard > APPLY or SKIP). Power bar visible.

name: main_skin_mode_on
how: Skin probe connected, SKIN MODE enabled in Settings > MODES; select SKIN panel and TURN ON.

name: main_heater_error
how: Main screen (unlocked, alarm centre closed) with HEATER FAULT active: the TEMPERATURE block is hidden. Start the board with the heater disconnected.

name: main_humidity_on
how: HUMIDITY CONTROL enabled; humidity TURN ON.

name: main_photo_on_continuous
how: Phototherapy ON (eye-protection popup > TURN ON), timer not started.

name: main_photo_timer_running
how: Phototherapy ON and START pressed: RUNNING and red X visible.

name: main_link_lost_chip
how: Disconnect the board link for more than 5 s: LINK LOST chip, values blank.

name: photo_safety_popup
how: Phototherapy TURN ON: the EYE PROTECTION REQUIRED popup, before confirming.

name: wizard_choose_baby
how: Temperature TURN ON: first wizard step (new or existing baby).

name: wizard_name
how: Wizard: NEW BABY > name step with keyboard (type a sample name, e.g. ZOE).

name: wizard_gest_age
how: Wizard: gestational age step.

name: wizard_weight
how: Wizard: weight step (empty field, NO WEIGHT button).

name: wizard_summary_range
how: Wizard summary in air mode with proposed range (e.g. 30 weeks, 1350 g).

name: wizard_summary_skin_sensor
how: Wizard summary in skin mode, with the skin probe placement picture.

name: lock_screen_air
how: Lock screen with temperature ON in air mode (touch the lock button).

name: lock_screen_spo2
how: Lock screen with the SpO2 probe applied: waveform, PR, SpO2 and PI.

name: lock_screen_noise
how: Lock screen with the noise indicator in the header (units with a noise sensor).

name: lock_unlock_prompt
how: Lock screen: touch and hold until the unlock border is half filled.

name: lock_alarm_banner_high
how: Lock screen with a HIGH priority alarm banner (e.g. AIR SENSOR FAULT). Needs a forced state.

name: lock_alarm_banner_med
how: Lock screen with a MEDIUM priority alarm banner (e.g. AIR TEMP HIGH). Needs a forced state.

name: lock_alarm_banner_low
how: Lock screen with a LOW priority alarm banner (e.g. HIGH NOISE).

name: menu
how: Main screen > menu button (three lines).

name: settings_info
how: Menu > SETTINGS > INFO.

name: settings_language
how: Menu > SETTINGS > LANGUAGE with the drop-down open.

name: settings_modes
how: Menu > SETTINGS > MODES, skin probe connected.

name: settings_modes_no_probe
how: Menu > SETTINGS > MODES with the skin probe disconnected (NO SKIN PROBE DETECTED).

name: settings_maintenance
how: Menu > SETTINGS > MAINTENANCE.

name: settings_wifi
how: Menu > SETTINGS > WIFI (do not show a real password).

name: alarm_center_active
how: Alarm centre with two active alarms (one HIGH, one MEDIUM).

name: alarm_center_silenced
how: Alarm centre with one alarm silenced (AUDIO PAUSED, RESUME button).

name: alarm_detail_popup
how: Alarm centre: touch an alarm card to open its description.

name: alarm_center_log
how: Alarm centre scrolled to the Log section with some entries.

name: alarm_test_banner
how: From the LOCK SCREEN: open the alarm centre and press TEST; capture while the ALARM TEST banner is shown (use w 2 and press TEST during the wait).

name: trend_4h
how: Alarm centre > TREND, 4 h window. Needs hours of real data.

name: babies_list
how: Menu > REGISTERED BABIES (active and history).

name: babies_weight_curve
how: REGISTERED BABIES > a baby > weight evolution.

name: baby_exit_dialog
how: With a baby registered, switch all functions off: 'Incubator idle' dialog.

name: maintenance_cleaning
how: Settings > MAINTENANCE > OPEN REMINDER (cleaning view with QR).

name: maintenance_service
how: Cleaning reminder > SERVICE (actuator hours).

name: weighing_reminder
how: Weighing reminder (appears on unlock when due). Hard to force.

name: help_menu
how: Menu > HELP.

name: help_contact_qr
how: Menu > HELP > CONTACT SUPPORT.

name: training_selector
how: Menu > HELP > GUIDED TUTORIAL (course selector).

name: training_lesson_banner
how: A lesson running, with the TRAINING or DEMO banner. Chamber empty.

name: training_certificate
how: Certificate after completing a course.

name: hw_test_grid
how: Settings > HARDWARE TEST, grid of results. Chamber empty.
